## Use case

Describe the CUDA program or engineering task to support. Link the upstream input
and its pinned version or commit when relevant.

## Current boundary

Identify the first unsupported stage or API and include the current diagnostic if
available. State the target hardware, toolchain, and conversion mode.

## Acceptance criteria

Describe what would count as success, separating source generation, target
compilation/linking, device correctness, and performance where relevant. For a
coverage goal, define the sample/file denominator and exclusions.
